_readme: Stage 3 Not applicable entries are calculators whose implemented method is a generic identity, unit conversion, empirical estimate or user-defined commercial calculation for which no single electrical standard governs the calculation method. Everything not listed here has a scope_screened entry in review_records.json. Scope-screened is NOT a completed licensed-text clause review; the UI must show it as Partial, not Done. No entry here implies Verified status or independent approval.

not_applicable.ac-ohms-law: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.agl-lamp-life-curve: Lamp life versus current is empirical and fitting-specific. The calculator interpolates manufacturer-provided life points; no universal AGL standard prescribes its exponent.
not_applicable.agl-light-intensity-distance: Allard’s law is an optical visibility relationship. This calculator is not an ICAO/DGCA RVR observation system or an approved RVR calculation; no AGL electrical standard governs the simplified illuminance-at-distance equation.
not_applicable.alternator-emf: Textbook synchronous-machine theory (EMF equation with pitch and distribution factors; regulation by the synchronous impedance method); no governing standard for the calculation. IEC 60034-4 covers how the machine quantities are tested and is not applied here
not_applicable.amps-to-kva: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.amps-to-kw: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.amps-to-watts: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.area-calculator: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.battery-charge-time: A simple capacity/current calculation is not a universal charging model. Charge profile, chemistry, temperature, absorption stage and charger control are manufacturer-specific.
not_applicable.battery-mah-wh: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.battery-series-parallel: Series voltage and parallel capacity are basic circuit relationships. Battery chemistry, cell arrangement and safety standards may apply to a project, but no single standard governs this generic relationship calculator.
not_applicable.binomial-distribution: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.bjt-base-resistor: The base-current/resistor calculation is a textbook approximation. Transistor gain, saturation voltage, switching and temperature limits must be taken from the device datasheet.
not_applicable.cable-power-loss: I²R loss is a textbook circuit identity. Cable resistance and installation data should be taken from the relevant conductor standard and manufacturer, but the equation itself has no separate governing calculation standard.
not_applicable.candela-lumens-beam: Candela, lumens and solid-angle relationships are photometric definitions. No separate design standard governs this idealized beam-angle conversion.
not_applicable.candela-lux-distance: The inverse-square illuminance relationship is a photometric identity. Lighting standards set application criteria, not this generic point-source conversion equation.
not_applicable.capacitance-series-parallel: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.circle-calculator: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.complex-number: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.copper-vs-aluminium: The calculator compares conductor resistivity using a textbook relationship. Material specifications and conductor resistance are standardized separately; no single standard governs this comparison equation.
not_applicable.dc-machine-emf-torque: Textbook machine relations (EMF and torque equations of a DC machine, armature voltage balance); no governing standard for the calculation
not_applicable.decibel: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.delta-wye: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.diode-circuit: Textbook diode relations (constant forward drop, the Shockley equation, the conduction angle and average and RMS output of a rectifier with a constant drop, and the diode clamp level); no governing standard for the calculation. Diode ratings, forward-drop and leakage limits and safe operating area are data-sheet specific and are not checked, and the repetitive peak reverse voltage margin is left to the designer.
not_applicable.distance-calculator: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.electricity-bill-slabs: Tariff slabs, fixed charges and taxes are utility/jurisdiction-specific; no single electrical standard governs this user-entered billing calculation.
not_applicable.energy-converter: Unit conversion; no governing standard for the method
not_applicable.energy-cost: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.energy-voltage-charge: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.ev-charge-time: Energy divided by charging power is a general estimate. EV charging standards specify EVSE characteristics, connection and safety, not a universal charging-time equation for all vehicles and charge profiles.
not_applicable.fan-pump-affinity: Fan and pump affinity laws are general similarity relationships. Application limits and performance curves are manufacturer-specific; no single standard governs this generic calculator.
not_applicable.frequency-period: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.generator-fuel: Fuel use is based on manufacturer-specific SFC and fuel density. No universal standard fixes the consumption value or this calculator’s simplified autonomy equation.
not_applicable.heatsink-thermal: The thermal-resistance network is a general heat-transfer calculation. Heatsink and semiconductor limits are manufacturer-specific; no single standard governs this simplified equation.
not_applicable.hp-kw-converter: Mechanical horsepower to watt conversion is a unit conversion, not a standards-governed electrical design method.
not_applicable.hybrid-system-sizing: Daily energy-balance sizing from user data (sun hours, performance ratio, efficiencies, depth of discharge, days of autonomy, generator loading and fuel use); no standard sets the method. Standards such as IEC 62548-1 and the battery and generator standards govern the installed system, not this first estimate
not_applicable.impedance-rlc: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.inductance-series-parallel: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.ir-temp-correction: The half-per-10-degree rule is a rule of thumb, not a universal insulation-resistance correction standard. Use the applicable test standard or manufacturer correction curve; do not treat this estimator as standards compliant.
not_applicable.kva-to-amps: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.kva-to-kw: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.kw-to-kva: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.kwh-to-kw: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.lc-energy: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.led-resistor: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.led-retrofit-payback: Energy savings and simple payback are arithmetic estimates. Tariff, operating hours, lamp life and project costs are site-specific; no single standard governs the payback equation.
not_applicable.line-phase: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.linear-interpolation: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.linear-regression: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.load-flow-3bus: Textbook network analysis (bus admittance matrix with Newton-Raphson and Gauss-Seidel power-flow iteration); no governing standard for the calculation. Voltage limits and planning criteria come from the grid code or utility and are not applied here
not_applicable.logarithm: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.lumens-lux-area: Lumen, illuminance and area relationships are photometric identities. Lighting standards set design criteria, but do not govern this generic unit/area conversion equation.
not_applicable.lumens-watts: Luminous efficacy is a ratio of source lumens to electrical watts. Actual efficacy is product-specific; this calculator uses a user-entered value and does not apply a standards table.
not_applicable.lux-to-watts: The calculation converts a user-selected illuminance target to approximate lamp power using user-entered UF, MF and efficacy. Lighting standards govern the target and design process, not this simplified conversion.
not_applicable.induced-emf: Textbook electromagnetic induction (Faraday's law, Lenz's law, motional EMF, flux linkage of a rotating coil); no governing standard for the calculation. Machine and winding standards set ratings and tests, not this identity
not_applicable.motor-efficiency-loss: Textbook loss model (fixed and load-dependent losses, efficiency from input and output power, slip ratio for load); IEC 60034-2-1 and IEC 60034-30-1 efficiency test methods and IE classes are not applied. Efficiencies and the loss split are user data
not_applicable.magnetic-flux-density: Textbook field relations (B = flux / area, B = mu0 mur H, Ampere's law for a solenoid and a straight conductor, field energy density); no governing standard for the calculation. Steel grades and saturation limits come from the material data
not_applicable.magnetic-circuit: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.matrix-calculator: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.load-schedule: Demand factors, diversity and spare margins depend on the adopted wiring code, occupancy and utility rules. The calculator sums user-entered load groups with their own demand and power factors (complex power) and does not implement a specific standard method.
not_applicable.maximum-demand: Demand and diversity factors depend on the adopted wiring code, occupancy and utility rules. The calculator accepts user-defined factors and does not implement a specific standard method.
not_applicable.mean-median-mode: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.millicandela-lumens-beam: This is a photometric unit/solid-angle conversion. No separate standard governs the idealized beam-angle equation.
not_applicable.motor-power-output: Textbook machine relation (slip, torque, shaft power, transformer efficiency); inputs come from the data sheet
not_applicable.motor-slip: Textbook machine relation (slip, torque, shaft power, transformer efficiency); inputs come from the data sheet
not_applicable.motor-torque: Textbook machine relation (slip, torque, shaft power, transformer efficiency); inputs come from the data sheet
not_applicable.neutral-current-unbalance: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.ohms-law: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.op-amp-gain: Ideal inverting and non-inverting gain are textbook circuit equations. Device bandwidth, offset, stability and output limits are manufacturer-specific.
not_applicable.per-unit-base: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.per-unit-convert: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.percentage-calculator: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.permutations-combinations: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.pf-capacitor-uf: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.pf-correction-kvar: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.phasor-sum: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.plant-load-flow: Textbook plant load estimation (group demand and diversity, complex power summation, transformer equivalent-circuit losses, capacitor correction); no governing standard for the calculation. Demand and coincidence factors, utility power-factor limits and transformer loading limits come from the project specification, the supply agreement or the applicable code and are not applied here
not_applicable.pt-ratio: The calculator applies the rated ratio (primary divided by secondary voltage), the usual ratio-error definition and a simple burden percentage. It does not implement the accuracy classes, voltage factors, phase displacement limits or test procedures of the instrument transformer standards; the 80% to 120% voltage and 25% to 100% burden ranges in the warnings are common class conditions to confirm in the project edition.
not_applicable.dc-dc-converter: Textbook switching-converter relations (continuous-conduction duty cycle with conduction losses, inductor and capacitor ripple, critical inductance); no governing standard for the calculation. EMC limits, converter product standards, switching and core loss and component ratings are not applied here, and this is a scope screen, not a clause review
not_applicable.load-factor: Textbook demand relations (load factor = average demand / maximum demand, demand factor, diversity factor); no governing standard for the calculation. Utility demand-interval definitions, tariff rules and code demand-factor tables are not applied, and this is a scope screen, not a clause review
not_applicable.adc-sampling: Textbook ADC and sampling relations (LSB = FSR / 2^N, ideal SNR 6.02 N + 1.76 dB, ENOB from SINAD, the Nyquist limit and aliasing); no governing standard for the calculation. IEEE 1241 and IEC 60748-4 test methods for converters, the data sheet test conditions and anti-alias filter design are not applied, and this is a scope screen, not a clause review
not_applicable.switching-loss-comparison: Textbook MOSFET loss relations (conduction I squared Rds D, overlap switching loss, gate charge loss, and the break-even frequency between devices); no governing standard for the calculation. Data sheet test conditions, device ratings and selection, thermal design and EMC are not applied, and this is a scope screen, not a clause review
not_applicable.controlled-rectifier: Textbook power-electronics relations for ideal phase-controlled thyristor rectifiers (average and RMS output against firing angle, continuous-conduction R-L-E loads, overlap from source inductance, input displacement and power factor); no governing standard for the calculation. Converter and drive product standards (for example the IEC 61800 series), input harmonic limits and thyristor ratings are not applied here, and this is a scope screen, not a clause review
not_applicable.two-wattmeter: Textbook three-phase power measurement theory (Aron connection: P = W1 + W2, Q = sqrt 3 (W1 - W2)); no governing standard for the calculation (IEC 62053 and IEC 61010 meter and safety requirements are not applied)
not_applicable.power-measurement: Textbook relations for the voltmeter, ammeter and wattmeter method and for an energy meter average (S = V I, P = W times the ratios, pf = P / S). The calculator does not implement the accuracy classes or test methods of the instrument and energy meter standards; instrument and transformer errors are not included.
not_applicable.power-converter: Unit conversion; no governing standard for the method
not_applicable.power-electronics-converter: Textbook power-electronics relations (ideal-diode rectifier averages and RMS, inverter fundamental and six-step content, buck, boost and buck-boost continuous-conduction design equations); no governing standard for the calculation. Input harmonic limits (for example IEC 61000-3-2), drive and converter product standards and component ratings are not applied here, and this is a scope screen, not a clause review
not_applicable.power-energy-time: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.power-factor: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.power-vi-solver: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.power-vir: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.powers-roots: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.probability-calculator: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.pump-motor-power: Hydraulic power and efficiency conversion are basic engineering relationships. Pump acceptance standards govern tests and performance, not this generic power equation.
not_applicable.pythagorean-theorem: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.quadratic-solver: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.rack-cooling: Heat load and airflow relationships are basic thermal calculations. Facility cooling design depends on equipment data and project thermal criteria; no single standard governs this calculator’s simplified equation.
not_applicable.ratio-calculator: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.rc-filter-cutoff: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.rc-time-constant: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.reactance: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.resistance-parallel: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.resistance-series: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.resonance-lc: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.rms-peak: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.rounding-sig-figs: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.simultaneous-equations: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.slope-calculator: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.standard-deviation: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.superposition-theorem: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.swg-wire: SWG is a historical gauge table conversion, not a current universal cable-selection or ampacity method. Gauge conversion does not establish conductor compliance or current-carrying capacity.
not_applicable.symmetrical-components: Textbook power-system analysis (Fortescue symmetrical components and the sequence-network connections for bolted faults); no governing standard for the calculation. Short-circuit current calculation to IEC 60909 or ANSI/IEEE C37 uses voltage factors, impedance corrections and motor contributions that are not applied here, and unbalance limits come from the supply or equipment standard in use
not_applicable.thevenin-norton: Textbook circuit theorem (Thevenin and Norton equivalents of a resistive network, maximum power transfer); no governing standard for the calculation
not_applicable.three-phase-current: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.three-phase-power: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.timer-555: The astable 555 timing equations are textbook approximations. Actual timing depends on IC variant, tolerances, threshold levels and manufacturer data.
not_applicable.transformer-efficiency: Textbook machine relation (slip, torque, shaft power, transformer efficiency); inputs come from the data sheet
not_applicable.transformer-test-data: Textbook equivalent-circuit reduction of open-circuit and short-circuit test readings; no governing standard for the calculation (test procedure and loss tolerances are set by the transformer standard and are not applied here)
not_applicable.triangle-calculator: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.trig-functions: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.vector-calculator: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.vipr-solver: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.voltage-divider: Textbook circuit identity (Ohm's law, power, series/parallel, AC circuit theory); no governing standard
not_applicable.volume-surface-area: Pure mathematics or statistics; no electrical standard governs the method
not_applicable.water-heater-kw: The heat-energy equation is a general thermodynamic identity. Heater sizing standards depend on the equipment and application, not this generic equation.
not_applicable.watts-to-amps: Textbook power and energy identity (single-phase, three-phase, power factor, per-unit); no governing standard
not_applicable.watts-to-lux: The calculator estimates illuminance from user-entered efficacy, utilisation and maintenance factors. Lighting standards govern design targets and verification, not this simplified estimate.
not_applicable.wind-power: The Betz/available-wind-power relationship is a physics equation. Wind-turbine standards govern power-performance measurement and turbine design, not this theoretical power estimate.
not_applicable.zener-regulator: The ideal shunt-regulator resistor equation is a textbook circuit method. Component tolerance, surge, thermal and safe-operating-area limits are datasheet-specific.
not_applicable.ac-dc-equivalent: Textbook circuit identity (RMS, average, form factor and crest factor of ideal waveforms; power in a resistor); no governing standard
not_applicable.kirchhoff-solver: Textbook circuit identity (Kirchhoff's current and voltage laws, Ohm's law, power balance for a resistive DC network); no governing standard
not_applicable.rc-rl-transient: Textbook circuit identity (first-order step response of a resistor with a capacitor or an inductor, tau = RC or L/R, exponential charge, discharge, rise and decay); no governing standard
not_applicable.rlc-transient: Textbook circuit identity (second-order step response of an ideal RLC circuit, damping ratio, overshoot, settling time); no governing standard
not_applicable.transformer-turns-ratio: Textbook identity for the ideal transformer (voltage ratio, turns ratio, volts per turn, rated currents, referred impedance); rating, test and tolerance requirements of IEC 60076 are not applied by this calculator
not_applicable.mesh-nodal-solver: Textbook circuit identity (mesh-current and node-voltage analysis, Ohm's law, bridge balance, power balance for a resistive DC network); no governing standard
not_applicable.vfd-speed: Textbook induction-motor relations (synchronous speed, slip, V/f voltage control, and the constant torque and constant power regions of a motor on a variable frequency drive); the standards for converter-fed motors and adjustable speed drives are not implemented, and no limit or clause from them is checked, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.laplace-transform: Textbook Laplace transform (defining integral, standard transform pairs, linearity, the second shifting theorem for a time delay, the initial and final value theorems, region of convergence); no governing standard, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.first-order-ode: Textbook first-order linear differential equation (integrating factor, particular and complementary solution, step, ramp and sine response, fourth-order Runge-Kutta check); no governing standard, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.derivative-integral: Textbook calculus (power rule, derivative and integral of sine and exponential functions, fundamental theorem of calculus, Simpson's rule); no governing standard
not_applicable.tou-demand-bill: Textbook time-of-use and demand-charge bill (energy = sum of kWh x rate by period, billed demand = larger of recorded and minimum percent of contract demand, demand charge = billed demand x rate, duty and tax as percent of subtotal); no standard sets the calculation and tariff rules come from the utility tariff order. Regulatory tariff orders, IEC 62053 meter classes and utility metering codes are not applied or reviewed here, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.load-energy-cost: Textbook real power and energy of an AC or DC load (P = sqrt3 x V x I x pf for balanced three-phase, E = P x hours x days, cost = E x tariff); no standard sets the calculation. IEC 61557-12 and IEC 62053 energy-meter classes, utility metering codes and tariff orders are not applied or reviewed here, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.replacement-savings: Textbook energy saving and simple payback of replacing equipment (energy = quantity x power x share of rating x hours x days, saving = existing less new, payback = investment / yearly cost saving); no standard sets the calculation. Energy audit and efficiency standards such as ISO 50001, ISO 50002 and BEE or IEC efficiency classes are not applied or reviewed here, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.electricity-bill-meter: Textbook bill arithmetic (units = reading difference x multiplier, telescopic or non-telescopic slab charges, fixed charges, surcharge, duty and tax as percentages of a subtotal); no standard sets the calculation. The tariff order of the utility or regulator governs the real bill and none is embedded or applied, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.multi-appliance-cost: Textbook energy and cost of a list of appliances (energy = quantity x power x share of rating x hours, summed over the rows, month = daily x days, year = daily x 365, cost = kWh x one flat tariff); no standard sets the calculation. Tariff orders and the utility's billing rules are not applied (slabs, fixed charges, duty, tax and time-of-use are outside it), and ISO 50002 and IS 14161 energy audit methods are not applied or reviewed here, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.electricity-cost-planner: Textbook energy of a list of appliances priced as a slab bill (units from the list, telescopic or non-telescopic slab energy charge, fixed charge, duty and tax as percentages, other charges) and the same bill again after one replacement; it combines the Multiple Appliance Electricity Cost, Electricity Bill from Meter Readings and Equipment Replacement Energy Savings calculators and no standard sets the calculation. A tariff order or utility billing rule is not applied (the slabs, rates and charges are your inputs; sanctioned-load, demand, time-of-use and surcharge items are outside it), and ISO 50002 and IS 14161 energy audit methods are not applied or reviewed here, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.energy-audit: Textbook energy balance (energy = power x load factor x hours, metered less surveyed energy, cost at a flat tariff); the 10% unaccounted-energy warning is a screening rule of thumb, not a limit from a standard, and energy audit standards such as ISO 50002 are not applied or reviewed here, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.energy-savings: Textbook energy-saving and investment arithmetic (motor input power at two efficiencies, lamp power difference with a controls cut, a supplied loss reduction, simple payback, discounted present value with a rising tariff, savings to investment ratio, emission factor); no governing standard sets the calculation. Energy audit and management standards (ISO 50001, ISO 50002, IEC 60034-30-1 efficiency classes) are not applied; a scope screen to confirm, not a clause review
not_applicable.thermal-rise: Textbook heat transfer (steady-state loss through an exposed surface with one overall coefficient, lumped thermal mass, air heat capacity for the ventilation flow); the formal temperature-rise verification of switchgear and controlgear assemblies (IEC 61439-1 and IEC TR 60890) has its own area and installation factors and is not applied here; the coefficients are typical enclosure figures, not standard values; a scope screen to confirm, not a clause review
not_applicable.bode-plot: Textbook frequency-response analysis (magnitude and phase of a rational open-loop transfer function with an ideal dead time, gain and phase crossovers, gain and phase margins and the Bode stability rule); no governing standard, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.signage-load: Textbook series-circuit arithmetic (lamp power times the number of signs, divided by an isolating transformer efficiency, plus I squared R cable loss, divided by the circuit current for the CCR voltage, and a search of the standard CCR sizes for the first that holds the design load at the chosen loading); every lamp load, transformer rating, efficiency, spare allowance and loading limit is entered by the user and is not looked up. ICAO Annex 14 Volume I (visual aids, including guidance signs), FAA AC 150/5345-44 (guidance signs), FAA AC 150/5345-10 (constant current regulators) and FAA AC 150/5345-47 (isolation transformers) set the equipment requirements and are not applied; a scope screen to confirm, not a clause review
not_applicable.contact-resistance: Textbook contact theory (Holm constriction resistance for a circular spot from contact force and hardness, film resistance per unit area, Kohlrausch relation between contact voltage and spot temperature); no standard sets the calculation. Connector and switchgear contact-resistance and temperature-rise test standards (for example the IEC 60512 series) and their acceptance limits are not applied, so this is a scope screen to confirm, not a clause review.
not_applicable.wavelength: Textbook electromagnetic-wave relations (wavelength = speed / frequency, speed c / sqrt(er mur), wave impedance eta0 sqrt(mur / er), electrical length as a fraction of a wavelength); the one-tenth-wavelength rule for transmission-line behaviour is a common rule of thumb, no standard sets the calculation, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.ev-range: Textbook battery-pack arithmetic (cells in series and parallel, nominal energy as voltage times capacity, health and temperature scaling) and energy-over-consumption range; the label test-cycle ranges (WLTP, EPA) and battery standards are not applied, no standard sets the calculation, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.pid-tuning: Textbook control-system tuning rules (Ziegler-Nichols reaction-curve and ultimate-gain settings, Cohen-Coon, Lambda / IMC and Tyreus-Luyben formulas applied to a first-order-plus-dead-time model or to an ultimate gain and period); these are published empirical recipes and no standard sets them, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.scr-triggering: Textbook thyristor gate-drive and resistor-triggering relations (gate resistor from VGT and IGT with a margin, gate power against the data-sheet ratings, firing angle asin(Vth/Vm) and half-wave load voltages); the limits are the user's data-sheet figures and no standard sets the calculation, so this is a scope screen to confirm, not a clause review.
not_applicable.reliability-indices: Outage-statistics definitions (SAIFI, SAIDI, CAIDI, ASAI, energy not supplied) as commonly reported for distribution systems, such as those in IEEE Std 1366; the calculator applies the definitions to the events entered, does not apply the standard's 5-minute momentary rule or major event day exclusion, and sets no regulator limits, so this is a scope screen to confirm, not a clause review.
not_applicable.electric-field: Textbook electrostatics (Coulomb field k q / r², vector superposition of point-charge fields, force F = q E); no governing standard, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
not_applicable.electric-potential: Textbook electrostatics (Coulomb potential kq/r, superposition of scalar potentials, work q0 V and the pair energy of a charge group, with epsilon0 from CODATA 2018); no governing standard sets the calculation, and no field simulation, conductor or dielectric-boundary model is included; a scope screen to confirm, not a clause review
not_applicable.calibration-error: Textbook calibration arithmetic (error as a percentage of span, as-found and as-left comparison against a user-set tolerance, least-squares zero and span error, test uncertainty ratio); no governing standard sets the calculation. The 4 : 1 ratio is a common practice guideline, not a requirement here, and traceability and uncertainty methods (ISO/IEC 17025, JCGM 100 GUM) are not applied; a scope screen to confirm, not a clause review
not_applicable.sensor-range-converter: Textbook linear scaling between a process range and a standard analogue signal band (4-20 mA, 0-20 mA, 0-10 V, 1-5 V, 0-5 V, 2-10 V); the 3.8 mA and 20.5 mA fault limits follow the NAMUR NE43 recommendation, which is not a standard and is not reviewed here, so this is a scope screen to confirm.
